# Local Adaptive Inference Runtime: Contraction & Healing Under GPU Pressure

A local adaptive inference runtime is a system that runs AI models on-device (or on a local server) and dynamically adjusts its behavior based on available compute resources. When GPU pressure rises—due to competing workloads, thermal throttling, memory contention, or concurrent requests—the runtime must **contract** (reduce its footprint) and later **heal** (restore full capability) without dropping requests or corrupting state.
